unplaced.detail: Verses attributed to Bhaviṣya for vows on aṣṭamī and later tithis have no secure place in the received Brāhma-parvan.
Additional śrāddha verses are attributed to Bhaviṣya, without a chapter by chapter match.
Several quoted lines have no match in the received text, including passages beginning bheryāṇi ca vādyāni, vimānam iti and dhana-dhānyam.
The work describes a Bhaviṣya text with saptamī-kalpa material; its aṣṭamī and navamī sections are absent from the received form used here.

Further verses attributed to Bhaviṣya, beyond the chapter matches above, are reported in Kālaviveka, Prayāścittaprakaraṇa, Aparārka’s Yājñavalkya commentary, Smṛticandrikā, Kullūka’s Manusmṛti commentary, Mādhavācārya’s Parāśara commentary, Madanapārijāta, Vratakālaviveka and Dīpakalikā; no chapter locus is established here.
